central-america-caribbean.title: Senchral Amerika an di Kyaribiyan
central-america-caribbean.description: Senchral Amerika an di Kyaribiyan — Yucatán, Belize, Guatemala, Honduras, El Salvador, Nicaragua, Costa Rica, Panama, Kyuuba, Jamieka, Hispaniola, di Kieman Ailan dem, Puerto Rico, di Lesa Antiliiz, an di sout paat a di Bahamas.

south-central-us.title: Sout Senchral Unaitid Stiet
south-central-us.description: Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, Louisiana, Kentucky, Tennessee, Mississippi an Alabama — Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Austin, Oklahoma City, Tulsa, Little Rock, New Orleans, Louisville, Nashville, Memphis, Jackson an Birmingham.

west-polynesia.title: Samoa an Tonga
west-polynesia.description: Samoa, Merikan Samoa, Tonga, Niue, Tokelau, an Wallis an Futuna — Apia, Pago Pago, Nukuʻalofa, Alofi an Mata-Utu; Upolu, Savaiʻi, Tutuila an di ailan dem a Tonga.

mariana-islands.title: Guam an di Nortan Mariana Ailan
mariana-islands.description: Guam an di Nortan Mariana Ailan dem — Hagåtña, Tamuning, Dededo, Saipan, Tinian an Rota.

greenland.title: Griinlan
greenland.description: Griinlan — Nuuk, Sisimiut, Ilulissat, Qaqortoq an Tasiilaq; di big ais shiit, di Ilulissat Icefjord an di fyord dem dong a sout.

bermuda.title: Bermuda
bermuda.description: Bermuda — Hamilton, St. George’s an di Royal Naval Dockyard, di ailan parish dem an im pink-san biich dem.

belarus.title: Belarus
belarus.description: Belarus — Minsk, Gomel, Mogilev, Vitebsk, Grodno an Brest; di Belovezhskaya Pushcha faris an di Polesia swamp dem.

channel-islands.title: Chanel Ailan
channel-islands.description: Jersey, Guernsey, Alderney, Sark an Herm — St Helier, St Peter Port an Gorey.

faroe-islands.title: Faroe Ailan
faroe-islands.description: Di Faroe Ailan dem — Tórshavn, Klaksvík, Runavík an di iitiin ailan, wid dem likl vilij, tonnel an sii klif.

svalbard.title: Svalbard
svalbard.description: Svalbard an Jan Mayen — Longyearbyen, Barentsburg an Ny-Ålesund; Spitsbergen glaasha an fyord dem.

malta.title: Malta
malta.description: Malta, Gozo an Comino — Valletta, Sliema, St Julian’s, Mdina, Victoria an di Chrii Siti dem.

madagascar-islands.title: Madagaska an di Indyan Oshan Ailan
madagascar-islands.description: Madagaska, di Comoros, Mayotte, Réunion, Mauritius an di Seychelles — Antananarivo, Toamasina, Moroni, Mamoudzou, Saint-Denis, Port Louis an Victoria.

sudan.title: Sudan
sudan.description: Sudan — Khartoum, Omdurman, Port Sudan, Kassala, El Obeid an Nyala; we di Bluu Nail an di Wait Nail miit, an di piramid dem a Meroë.

cabo-verde.title: Cabo Verde
cabo-verde.description: Cabo Verde — Praia, Mindelo, Santa Maria an di ten ailan, fram Santo Antão go dong a Brava.

sao-tome-principe.title: São Tomé an Príncipe
sao-tome-principe.description: São Tomé an Príncipe — São Tomé, Santo António an di tuu ailan rienfaris an biich dem.

saint-helena.title: Saint Helena, Ascension an Tristan da Cunha
saint-helena.description: Saint Helena, Ascension Ailan an Tristan da Cunha — Jamestown, Georgetown an Edinburgh of the Seven Seas.

bangladesh.title: Bangladesh
bangladesh.description: Bangladesh — Dhaka, Chittagong, Khulna, Rajshahi, Sylhet an Cox’s Bazar; di Sundarbans an di Ganges–Brahmaputra delta.

sri-lanka-maldives.title: Sri Lanka an di Maldives
sri-lanka-maldives.description: Sri Lanka an di Maldives — Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Jaffna, Trincomalee, Anuradhapura an Malé; di hil konchri, Sigiriya an di atoll dem.

vietnam.title: Vietnam
vietnam.description: Vietnam — Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Da Nang, Hai Phong, Hue, Hoi An an Can Tho; Ha Long Bay an di Mekong Delta.

philippines.title: Filipiinz
philippines.description: Di Filipiinz — Manila, Quezon City, Cebu, Davao, Iloilo, Baguio an Zamboanga; Luzon, di Visayas, Mindanao an Palawan.

indonesia.title: Indonisha an Timor-Leste
indonesia.description: Indonisha an Timor-Leste — Jakarta, Surabaya, Bandung, Medan, Yogyakarta, Denpasar, Makassar an Dili; Java, Sumatra, Bali, Borneo, Sulawesi an Papua.

malaysia-singapore-brunei.title: Malaysia, Singapore an Brunei
malaysia-singapore-brunei.description: Malaysia, Singapore an Brunei — Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, George Town, Johor Bahru, Malacca, Kota Kinabalu, Kuching an Bandar Seri Begawan.

myanmar.title: Myanmar
myanmar.description: Myanmar — Yangon, Mandalay, Naypyidaw, Bagan, Mawlamyine an Inle Lake; di Irrawaddy vali an di Shan hil dem.

cambodia-laos.title: Kambodia an Laos
cambodia-laos.description: Kambodia an Laos — Phnom Penh, Siem Reap an Angkor, Battambang, Vientiane, Luang Prabang an Pakse; di Mekong an di Tonlé Sap.

colombia.title: Kolombia
colombia.description: Kolombia — Bogotá, Medellín, Cali, Barranquilla, Cartagena an Bucaramanga; di Andiiz, di Kyaribiyan kuos an di Amazon.

venezuela.title: Venezuela
venezuela.description: Venezuela — Caracas, Maracaibo, Valencia, Barquisimeto, Mérida an Ciudad Bolívar; Angel Falls, di Orinoco an Isla Margarita.

peru.title: Peru
peru.description: Peru — Lima, Arequipa, Cusco, Trujillo, Iquitos an Puno; Machu Picchu, Lake Titicaca an di Sacred Valley.

ecuador.title: Ekwador
ecuador.description: Ekwador — Quito, Guayaquil, Cuenca, Manta an Baños; di Avenue of the Volcanoes, di Amazon an di Galápagos Ailan dem.

bolivia.title: Bolivia
bolivia.description: Bolivia — La Paz, El Alto, Santa Cruz, Cochabamba, Sucre an Potosí; Lake Titicaca an di Salar de Uyuni.

chile.title: Chile
chile.description: Chile — Santiago, Valparaíso, Concepción, Antofagasta, La Serena an Punta Arenas; di Atacama, di Lake District, Patagonia an Iista Ailan.

paraguay-uruguay.title: Paraguay an Uruguay
paraguay-uruguay.description: Paraguay an Uruguay — Asunción, Ciudad del Este, Encarnación, Montevideo, Punta del Este an Colonia del Sacramento.

guianas.title: Di Guiana Dem
guianas.description: Guyana, Suriname an French Guiana — Georgetown, Paramaribo, Cayenne an Kourou; Kaieteur Falls an di rienfaris pan di Guiana Shield.

falklands.title: Falkland Ailan
falklands.description: Di Falkland Ailan dem — Stanley, Goose Green an di ailan dem a East an West Falkland.

australia.title: Ostrielia
australia.description: Ostrielia — Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, Adelaide, Hobart, Darwin an Canberra; di Great Barrier Reef, Uluru an di Outback.

new-zealand.title: Nyuu Ziilan
new-zealand.description: Nyuu Ziilan — Auckland, Wellington, Christchurch, Hamilton, Dunedin an Queenstown; di Southern Alps, Fiordland an Rotorua.

british-columbia.title: British Columbia
british-columbia.description: British Columbia — Vancouver, Victoria, Kelowna, Kamloops, Prince George an Whistler; di Coast Mountains, Vancouver Ailan an di Okanagan.

canadian-prairies.title: Kianieda Prierii
canadian-prairies.description: Alberta, Saskatchewan an Manitoba — Calgary, Edmonton, Winnipeg, Saskatoon, Regina an Banff; di Rakiiz, di prierii an Churchill pan Hudson Bay.

ontario.title: Ontario
ontario.description: Ontario — Toronto, Ottawa, Mississauga, Hamilton, London, Kingston an Thunder Bay; Niagara Falls, di Great Lakes an Algonquin Park.

quebec.title: Quebec
quebec.description: Quebec — Montréal, Quebec City, Laval, Gatineau, Sherbrooke an Saguenay; di St. Lawrence, di Laurentians an di Gaspé Peninsula.

atlantic-canada.title: Atlantik Kianieda
atlantic-canada.description: New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, Prince Edward Island, an Newfoundland an Labrador — Halifax, St. John’s, Moncton, Saint John, Fredericton an Charlottetown; di Cabot Trail an di Bay of Fundy.

northern-canada.title: Nortan Kianieda
northern-canada.description: Yukon, di Northwest Territories an Nunavut — Whitehorse, Yellowknife, Iqaluit, Dawson City an Inuvik; di Arctic Archipelago an di Mackenzie River.

hong-kong-macau.title: Hong Kong an Macau
hong-kong-macau.description: Hong Kong an Macau — Hong Kong Ailan, Kowloon, di New Territories, Lantau an di Macau Peninsula, Taipa an Coloane.
